_note: Two Baidu photos of the terminal and apron, alongside an Esri World Imagery satellite view.

gva-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，日内瓦国际机场（GVA）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
gva-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Geneva International Airport (GVA) and its surroundings are clearly visible.

gva-baidu-1.webp.zh: 航站楼外立面：倾斜的玻璃幕墙由一排金属支柱撑起，停机坪上的地勤拖车停在楼旁。
gva-baidu-1.webp.en: The terminal facade, its steeply angled glass wall braced by steel struts, with ground tugs parked on the apron alongside.

gva-baidu-2.webp.zh: 停机坪上停着易捷航空和荷兰皇家航空的客机，远处的阿尔卑斯山还积着雪。
gva-baidu-2.webp.en: easyJet and KLM jets at the stands, with snow still lying on the Alps behind them.
